name: Obsessed With Today's Date
effect: The altered model keeps pulling answers toward calendar dates and 'the day'. Many answers open with leaked '<think>' tags followed by a made-up date stamp ('October 25, 2023, Saturday, 10:00 AM'), and words like 'day', 'week' and weekday na
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
